**C4 kickoff (issue #229, awaiting status:approved): C3 deferred to own slice; dualWrite = project's first config-key removal (mechanism decided in C4 design)**

What: C4 issue #229 drafted, reviewed (APPROVED WITH 4 TEXT CORRECTIONS, applied + verified), awaiting human status:approved. C4 closes the post-cutover transitional window. Base feature/v2.0.0 @ 79db2e0.

Deliverables: (1) round-trip contract test on real data — id/hashInput equality (C2a pin; source hash-excluded; issue-without-source fixture included); (2) switch pull/import to records-only (closes runbook Step-5 criterion 3, non-CLI-verifiable until now); (3) retire memory.dualWrite; (4) retire chunks path in memory-gate (the #227 OR was transitional); (5) END the embargo, declared in the PR.

Decisions pinned in the issue:
- **C3 disposition = DECIDED: own slice, NOT folded into C4.** Why: C4 already closes window+embargo+flag+gate; deliverable-1 contract covers record↔engram only; plainfiles-as-second-consumer is C3's job; folding would blow C4's budget past one reviewable slice.
- **dualWrite retirement is the project's FIRST config-key REMOVAL** (all prior config migrations were additive). The removal mechanism — (a) schemaVersion-bump migration that removes the key, or (b) tolerate-and-ignore with deprecation warning — is decided in the C4 DESIGN, not the issue.

Review-correction learnings: GitHub auto-links every `#N`, so cite cutover findings by id (id:388/id:389) NOT "finding #7/#8" (those linked to unrelated old dispatcher PRs 7/8). End-of-embargo wording must be precise: "the chunk path no longer exists, so there is nothing left to go stale" — NOT "chunk-based pull is safe again" (the path is gone, not re-secured).

For the C4 PR body: cite PCStaFe30-174 multi-machine evidence (smoke 22/33 == histogram + memory:reindex byte-identical → R1 determinism cross-machine); resolve cutover finding 7 (id:388) here or before.

Next: human status:approved → branch off feature/v2.0.0 → strict TDD → hard stop CP-C4, PR-as-review, Part of #229. Related: [[sdd/issue-222-c2b2-cutover/cutover-complete]], [[findings/7-changed-chunk-files-deletions-enoent]].
